metadata.epic5_selection_trial_method: Three sequential independent isolated PostgreSQL fixtures; each serial scenario uses five excluded warmups and 120 measured invocations with DEBUG=False.
metadata.methodology: RR-05.2 candidate placeholders are replaced only by three independent guarded isolated PostgreSQL trials. Prompt-context and verified comparison discovery use bounded Registry-local cached-selection revalidation.

selection_sql_attribution.selection_prompt_context: Existing inclusive Registry stage events are shown only for prompt-context scenarios and are never summed with nested stages.
selection_sql_attribution.whole_operation: Django execute_wrapper records exact operation-level SQL count and wrapper duration for every scenario; it cannot attribute statements to authorization, namespace admission, visibility, version validation, or context assembly.
